label: Intake & map screen words

params.name: lede
params.default: Upload a client's statements for the year. Every row with a figure gets its SF Ref - the 3CD clause or ITR schedule it belongs to.
params.label: lede

params.name: pick_lede
params.default: Choose whose statements to work on.
params.label: pick lede

params.name: no_files
params.default: No statements yet for this year. Upload the client's Excel - Tally exports saved as Excel work too.
params.label: no files

params.name: pan_missing
params.default: client PAN not found in this file
params.label: pan missing

params.name: delete_body
params.default: The uploaded file and every SF Ref saved for its rows are removed.
params.label: delete body

params.name: ref_hint
params.default: e.g. 3CD 31(a) #2 or ITR3 HP - several joined with ;
params.label: ref hint

params.name: bad_ay
params.default: {ay} is not an assessment year this portal offers.
params.label: bad ay

params.name: bad_type
params.default: SimplyFile reads .xlsx, .xls, .xlsm, .csv - and text PDFs best-effort. {why}
params.label: bad type

params.name: too_big
params.default: That file is larger than {mb} MB.
params.label: too big

params.name: unreadable
params.default: {name} could not be read. If it opens in Excel, save it again as .xlsx and upload that.
params.label: unreadable

params.name: too_many_rows
params.default: {n} rows is more than the {most} a file may have.
params.label: too many rows

params.name: same_file
params.default: {name} is already uploaded for this year.
params.label: same file

params.name: bad_ref
params.default: {ref} is not an SF Ref. Write <form> <table> [#serial], e.g. 3CD 31(a) #2 or ITR3 HP.
params.label: bad ref

params.name: none_open
params.default: Nothing needs a person - every row carries an SF Ref.
params.label: none open

params.name: year_progress
params.default: {done} of {n} {n:row|rows} across {files} {files:file|files} carry an SF Ref
params.label: year progress

params.name: next_recon
params.default: Mapped the statements? Check them against 26AS, AIS and TIS.
params.label: next recon

params.name: leave_unsaved
params.default: You have unsaved SF Refs. Leave without saving?
params.label: leave unsaved

params.name: enter_hint
params.default: Enter moves to the next row
params.label: enter hint

params.name: group_net
params.default: Rows added, Less: rows taken off; tax lines and the statement's own total left out.
params.label: group_net

params.name: group_agrees
params.default: Adds up to the statement's own total, {stated}.
params.label: group_agrees

params.name: group_differs
params.default: Does not add up: the statement says {stated}.
params.label: group_differs

params.name: replace_ask
params.default: {name} is already here. Replace it with this one? Refs stay on rows whose place and words did not change; the old version is kept.
params.label: replace_ask

params.name: cant_save_as
params.default: Open it in Excel and save it as .xlsx (Excel Workbook), then upload that.
params.label: cant save as

params.name: cant_tally_xml
params.default: Tally's XML or JSON export is not read. In Tally, export the report to Excel (.xlsx) instead.
params.label: cant tally xml

params.name: cant_picture
params.default: A photo or scan cannot be read - SimplyFile has no text recognition. Ask for the Excel, or a PDF with text in it.
params.label: cant picture

params.name: cant_word
params.default: A Word document is not read. Copy the table into Excel and save it as .xlsx.
params.label: cant word

params.name: cant_other
params.default: Save it as .xlsx from Excel and upload that.
params.label: cant other

params.name: locked
params.default: {name} is password-protected. Open it in Excel, remove the password (File - Info - Protect Workbook), save, and upload again.
params.label: locked

params.name: pdf_scan
params.default: {name} is a scanned PDF (pictures of pages, no text). SimplyFile cannot read scans. Ask for the Excel, or a PDF with text.
params.label: pdf scan

params.name: pdf_warn
params.default: Read from a PDF: columns can shift when a PDF is read. Check every row and its amount before mapping.
params.label: pdf warn

params.name: two_sided_note
params.default: Two-sided statement: the left and right sides were read as separate rows.
params.label: two sided note

params.name: formats_ok
params.default: Excel (.xlsx, .xls, .xlsm) and CSV (comma, semicolon or tab; UTF-8 or Windows) - every sheet, in the usual statement layouts (headings, a label, amounts); amounts as numbers or as text (1,23,456 Dr, (12,500), Rs 5,000); two-sided statements (liabilities | assets). SimplyFile suggests an SF Ref where it recognises a row; a person accepts or changes it.
params.label: formats ok

params.name: formats_partly
params.default: Text PDFs - best-effort: check every row.
params.label: formats partly

params.name: formats_no
params.default: Not read: scanned PDFs and photos (no text recognition), password-protected files, .xlsb / .ods / Numbers (save as .xlsx), Tally XML / JSON (export to Excel), Word.
params.label: formats no
